_comment: Canonical runtime values for ship-milestone. SKILL.md prose explains the handshake/labels semantics; this file is the source of truth for the literal values. Update here only — do not duplicate in SKILL.md.
_base_branch_note: All milestone PRs base on and merge into `develop`. `main` is production: promoting develop -> main requires explicit human sign-off and is OUTSIDE this skill.

ready_for_review.name: ready-for-review
ready_for_review.meaning: Orchestrator applies after implement+verify+green-gate (+visual PASS for UI). Signals reviewer (Alice) to pick up the PR.

ready_to_merge.name: ready-to-merge
ready_to_merge.meaning: Reviewer (Alice) applies when the PR is good to merge. THE ONLY merge trigger — never merge on green alone.

needs_operator.name: needs-operator
needs_operator.meaning: Orchestrator applies on 3-strike escalation. PR is parked; orchestrator does not touch it again until operator responds.

web.preferred: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
web.fallback_docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/web":/w -w /w node:22 sh -c 'npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test'
web.fallback_remote: quasar-host skill: `qhost test web-check` (runs on the configured host, default the gpu-test role)
web._note: pnpm >=11 / Node <22 trap: use node:22 + npm, not pnpm.

control_plane._note: go-test-db requires a live Postgres; plain go-check skips DB tests silently. -p 1 mandatory (shared DB, truncate in setup).

node_agent.fallback_remote: quasar-host skill: `qhost test check node-agent` / `qhost test test node-agent`
node_agent._note: Must run inside quasar-agent-dev container (no GStreamer/Rust/Wayland on the Mac host).
